usageNotes: Use this to resume a suspended LXC container; the container must already be in a suspended state (not stopped or running). The call returns a task UPID string that can be polled via the tasks API to confirm completion. The caller must hold the VM.PowerMgmt privilege on /vms/{vmid}.

examples.summary: Resume a suspended LXC container (vmid 201) on node pve1

tips: Check container status first with GET /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/status/current — resuming a non-suspended container will fail.
The returned string is a UPID; poll GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm the resume completed successfully.
LXC resume is near-instant; if the task lingers, check whether the container's rootfs storage is accessible on the node.
